summary: Itaú Unibanco filed a Form 6-K announcing a BRL 3 billion issuance of Perpetual Subordinated Financial Bills to professional investors, classified as Additional Tier 1 capital under Brazilian Central Bank Resolutions 122 and 5.007. The perpetual securities can be repurchased from 2031 subject to regulatory approval. The estimated impact on the Tier 1 capital ratio is 19 basis points based on the March 31, 2026 capital base. This is a routine capital management transaction—a perpetual debt issuance—not a special situation such as a tender offer, restructuring, or going-private event. There are no acquisition, divestiture, activist, or strategic review elements. The filing does not trigger any special-situation category.
